authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4784.3 *cikkhalla explicitly gives Bengali cikal and Hindi/Gujarati/Marathi cikhal mud. Bhatri cikəl/cikʌl fits this retained-k branch; the ungeminated cikhalla branch instead gives Hindi cihlā. The lack of aspiration is retained. Exact survey form cikəl is preserved.
